# Vakkalittheragāthā (Thag 5.8)

**ID:** Thag 5.8
**Section:** Theragāthā (thag)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Vakkalittheragāthā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0508m.mul4.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In modern scholarship, Andrea Schlosser references the Khuddakanikāya commentary on this poem (*Vakkalittheragāthāvaṇṇanā*), which glosses the verbal form *viharissāmi* as abiding in the bliss of the path (*maggasukha*), fruition (*phalasukha*), and extinction (*nibbānasukha*) by cultivating the factors of awakening (*bodhipakkhiyadhammā*) [Schlosser 2016].
